```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggquiver)
library(terra)
```

```{r}
url <- "https://ncss.hycom.org/thredds/ncss/GLBv0.08/expt_53.X/data/2012?var=water_u&var=water_v&north=32.5&west=-80&east=-73&south=26.5&disableProjSubset=on&horizStride=1&time=2012-12-31T21%3A00%3A00Z&vertCoord=0.0&addLatLon=true&accept=netcdf"

# Download the NetCDF file
download.file(url, "hycom.nc", mode = "wb")

r <- rast("hycom.nc")

coords_matrix <- xyFromCell(r, 1:ncell(r))

long=coords_matrix[,1]
lat=coords_matrix[,2]
velocity_u=values(hycom$`water_u_depth=0`)
velocity_v=values(hycom$`water_v_depth=0`)

hycom_df=data.frame(
  lat=lat,
  long=long,
  velocity_u=velocity_u,
  velocity_v=velocity_v
)

#gets a subset of the data set to plot
n=20
hycom_df_filtered <- hycom_df[seq(1, nrow(hycom_df), n), ]

#scales the vector size with a sigmoid function
a=1
hycom_df_filtered$water_u_depth.0=a*(1/(1+exp(-hycom_df_filtered$water_u_depth.0)))-(a/2)
hycom_df_filtered$water_v_depth.0=a*(1/(1+exp(-hycom_df_filtered$water_v_depth.0)))-(a/2)

ggplot(hycom_df_filtered) + 
  geom_quiver(
    aes(x=long, y=lat, u=water_u_depth.0, v=water_v_depth.0),
    vecsize = 0
  ) +coord_sf(xlim = c(min(hycom_df_filtered$long),max(hycom_df_filtered$long)), ylim = c(min(hycom_df_filtered$lat),max(hycom_df_filtered$lat)), expand = FALSE) 
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggquiver)
```


```{r}
# boiler plate code
library(maps)
world <- sf::st_as_sf(map('world', plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))

ggplot(seals) + 
  geom_quiver(
    aes(x=long, y=lat, u=delta_long, v=delta_lat),
    vecsize=0
  ) + 
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-173.8, -117.8), ylim = c(28.7, 50.7), expand = FALSE) + 
  labs(title = "Seal movements", x = NULL, y = NULL)
```
